item.title: Agnikul’s Quad-Engine Test Proves India's Private Launch Viability
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
India's private space sector just cleared a massive hurdle. Agnikul Cosmos successfully test-fired a cluster of four semi-cryogenic engines simultaneously, redefining the country's responsive launch calculus.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The breakthrough validates the core architecture of the Agnibaan launch vehicle for responsive deployment. [SPLIT] ⚡ Heavy reliance on 3D-printing and domestic manufacturing underscores the maturation of the Atmanirbhar Bharat defense and space industrial base. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/agnikul-s-quad-engine-test-proves-india-s-private-launch-viability-038377.html

item.description:
Union MoS Defence Sanjay Seth has landed in Brussels for the Schuman Security and Defence Forum 2026. Here is what this high-stakes diplomatic push means for India-EU defense co-development and Indo-Pacific deterrence.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Ambassador Pranay Verma received Seth, signaling intense diplomatic alignment between India and the European Union. [SPLIT] ⚡ The dialogue pivots away from legacy defense procurement toward co-development and joint R&D ventures. item.title: Weaponized SaaS Supply Chains: Inside the Optimizely Malware Exploitation
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A silent compromise within Optimizely’s trusted CDN delivered advanced iOS exploit kits and card skimmers across 178 major enterprise sites, including Zoom, Salesforce, and the BBC. Strategic intelligence analyst Alexander Sterling unpacks this digital supply chain assault.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The attack payload featured advanced iOS exploit kits (Coruna and DarkSword) linked to Russian state-aligned threat actors alongside commercial financial skimming engines. [SPLIT] ⚡ High-value enterprise and media portals—including Zoom, Salesforce, CNN, and the BBC—served as unintended distribution vectors for high-tier mobile zero-day and N-day exploits. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/weaponized-saas-supply-chains-inside-the-optimizely-malware-exploitation-005870.html

item.title: Astra Microwave Locks March 2027 Deadline for First Uttam Radars
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Astra Microwave has locked in a March 2027 deadline to deliver its first two indigenous Uttam AESA radars for the Tejas Mk1A, injecting critical momentum into India's indigenous combat aviation roadmap.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The ₹1,844 crore production order forms the bedrock of Astra's current consolidated order book, which stands at ₹4,708 crore. [SPLIT] ⚡ The indigenous AESA radar milestone directly addresses long-standing bottlenecks in the Tejas Mk1A manufacturing pipeline. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/astra-microwave-locks-march-2027-deadline-for-first-uttam-radars-953119.html

item.title: GE’s F404 Supply Slump Stalls Tejas Mk1A Production Lines
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Supply chain friction hits Atmanirbhar Bharat as GE Aerospace struggles to maintain the promised four-engine monthly delivery rate for the HAL Tejas Mk1A.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The ongoing supply shortfall disrupts HAL's final assembly lines, leaving multiple Tejas Mk1A airframes completed but grounded without propulsion systems. [SPLIT] ⚡ Meeting the government's year-end target of 22 cumulative engines now hinges entirely on an aggressive delivery surge throughout December. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/ge-s-f404-supply-slump-stalls-tejas-mk1a-production-lines-953159.html

item.description:
As geopolitical fault lines shift across the Indo-Pacific, Prime Minister Modi lands in Manila for the ASEAN-India and East Asia Summits. Here is how New Delhi is anchoring maritime deterrence and countering unilateral hegemony in the region.

item.title: Starship’s Tower Catch Signals a New Era of Responsive Space Power
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
SpaceX's tower catch of the returning Starship isn't just a lunar milestone—it fundamentally redefines responsive space power, orbital asset reconstitution, and global strategic logistics.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Demonstrated payload deployment during orbital flight underscores the system's immediate utility for rapid satellite constellation replenishment. [SPLIT] ⚡ Super-heavy reusability shifts space deterrence, allowing defense forces to out-pace adversary anti-satellite denial through rapid orbital reconstitution. item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The architect of the AI boom has fallen. Jensen Huang's sudden resignation from Nvidia over a sprawling scandal marks a tectonic shift for global tech.

item.title: Inside Pakistan’s air-to-air missile arsenal: From Chinese PL-15s to indigenous Fa’az
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Pakistan's recent flight-test of its indigenous Fa'az air-to-air missile signals a new push for self-reliance. How does it stack up against Chinese imports and India's air defense posture? Read our strategic breakdown.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The Fa'az is being developed by GIDS under NESCOM in two distinct variants: a passive imaging infrared (IIR) version and an active radar-guided (RF) version. [SPLIT] ⚡ Strategic analysts debate the true indigenous depth of the Fa’az, noting potential technological linkages with Turkish defense entities like TÜBİTAK SAGE. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/inside-pakistan-s-air-to-air-missile-arsenal-from-chinese-pl-15s-to-indigenous-f-832185.html

item.title: When the Cloud Stalls: India’s Vulnerability to Global Tech Outages
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
When Microsoft 365 went dark for hundreds of thousands of Indians last November, it laid bare a harsh reality: our digital sovereignty is tethered to foreign cloud giants. Read the Neodymium World strategic brief.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The disruption primarily targeted Exchange Online, crippling critical cloud-based messaging, calendars, and organizational task coordination. [SPLIT] ⚡ The incident exposes the systemic risk of centralizing institutional workflows within hyper-scale cloud platforms operated by foreign multinationals. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/when-the-cloud-stalls-india-s-vulnerability-to-global-tech-outages-743336.html

item.title: Astra Delivers First Virupaksha AESA Radar Prototype to DRDO
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
India's indigenous air defense gets a major boost as Astra Microwave delivers the first Virupaksha AESA radar prototype hardware to DRDO for the Su-30MKI fleet.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The system is developed by LRDE under DRDO to replace the aging Russian N011M Bars radar on the IAF Su-30MKI fleet. [SPLIT] ⚡ The radar features approximately 2,400 Gallium Nitride transmit-receive modules across a 950mm antenna array. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/astra-delivers-first-virupaksha-aesa-radar-prototype-to-drdo-654938.html

item.title: Silicon Leak: Alice Huang's Network and the Nvidia Chip Breach
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A high-stakes chip scandal exposes severe vulnerabilities in US export controls, as banned Nvidia processors route straight to Chinese networks via Singapore intermediaries.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The scandal led to the abrupt resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following revelations of improper personal ties to Alice Huang. [SPLIT] ⚡ Singapore-based intermediaries like Megaspeed International and Aperia Cloud Services are facing active international investigations. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/silicon-leak-alice-huang-s-network-and-the-nvidia-chip-breach-570971.html

item.title: Sovereign Tech Fallout: Global Cloud Outage Exposes Critical Risks
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
When a cloud outage paralyzes the UK NHS, European exchanges, and Indian enterprises, it reveals an uncomfortable truth: single-vendor software monopolies are a strategic threat to national security. Here is our deep-dive analysis.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Unplanned SaaS disruptions open dangerous shadow-IT attack vectors as personnel migrate sensitive communications to unmonitored personal accounts. [SPLIT] ⚡ India's digital transition requires multi-vendor diversification and open-source stacks rather than replacing one foreign platform monopoly with a domestic equivalent. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/sovereign-tech-fallout-global-cloud-outage-exposes-critical-risks-571119.html

item.title: Windows Zero-Day SignDrop Exploit Grants System Rights Via CLFS
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A disgruntled researcher just dropped 'SignDrop', a Windows zero-day exploiting the Common Log File System and Windows Defender to grant full System rights. Here is the technical breakdown.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The attack ingeniously weaponizes an October 2025 Microsoft security mitigation against itself by manipulating Object Manager symbolic links. [SPLIT] ⚡ Veteran security researcher Will Dormann successfully reproduced the exploit, noting it requires specific build parameters and authentication modes. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/windows-zero-day-signdrop-exploit-grants-system-rights-via-clfs-682673.html

item.title: Silicon Valley's Geopolitical Blind Spot and the Nvidia Crisis
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Tech visionaries thought they could navigate geopolitics unscathed. Between political miscalculations in Washington and hardware leaks in Singapore, Silicon Valley's supply chain hubris is catching up.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Nvidia's hardware tracking feasibility confirms that mandatory geofencing for advanced AI chips is technically achievable despite industry pushback. [SPLIT] ⚡ Complex transshipment hubs like Singapore remain critical vulnerabilities in preventing restricted silicon from reaching adversarial states. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/silicon-valley-s-geopolitical-blind-spot-and-the-nvidia-crisis-602813.html

item.title: When Brain Implants Come Out, the Real Neural Ethics Begin
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Experimental brain implants give patients extraordinary new capabilities—until funding runs out or trials end. Meet the BCI pioneers demanding a voice, data ownership, and permanent protection.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The new guidelines insist that neural data must be treated strictly as personal information, free from restrictive NDAs. [SPLIT] ⚡ Participants face severe psychological and physical dislocation when hardware is removed due to funding lapses or corporate insolvency. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/when-brain-implants-come-out-the-real-neural-ethics-begin-602829.html

item.title: Exclusive: First Tejas Mk1A Headed for January 2027 Delivery
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The long-awaited Tejas Mk1A is finally nearing induction. Sources confirm the first jets could hit the IAF tarmac by January 2027, just ahead of Aero India, bypassing crucial developmental bottlenecks. Read our deep-dive analysis.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Initial delivery slippages from the February 2024 baseline were driven primarily by delayed shipments of GE F404-IN20 turbofan engines from the United States. [SPLIT] ⚡ To expedite induction, the IAF has agreed to temporary operational concessions regarding Israeli EL/M-2052 AESA radar software integration. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/exclusive-first-tejas-mk1a-headed-for-january-2027-delivery-832208.html

item.description:
Google DeepMind just dropped Gemini 4 Hydrogen, an enterprise-grade execution engine built to power multi-agent workflows, slash latency, and outpace previous models across complex software development tasks. Here is the strategic breakdown.

item.title: The Great Gatekeeping: Why United Grounded Autonomous AI Agents
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
AI can draft your emails and write your code, but United Airlines just slammed the door on personal agents booking flights. Here is why autonomous transactions hit a regulatory wall.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Federal aviation mandates require direct user attestation regarding hazardous materials and explosives in luggage. [SPLIT] ⚡ Major enterprises, including eBay and leading financial institutions, are similarly erecting barriers against autonomous web scrapers and agents. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/the-great-gatekeeping-why-united-grounded-autonomous-ai-agents-485858.html

item.title: AlphaGenome 2 Bridges Single-Cell Biology and Human Genetics
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
AlphaGenome 2 is here. By training on over 100 million single-cell profiles, this next-gen AI model predicts how DNA variants impact specific human cell types and disease states like never before.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The model was trained on more than 107 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, integrating bulk and single-cell data. [SPLIT] ⚡ It identifies nearly twice as many variants that alter gene expression in specialized cells compared to previous iterations. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/alphagenome-2-bridges-single-cell-biology-and-human-genetics-431152.html

item.title: Grok Build Leak Exposes SpaceXSI Secrets and Thousands of Apps
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Vibe-coding has a major security problem. Over 35,000 Grok Build apps—including internal SpaceXSI sales and strategy data—were left wide open due to a basic DNS architecture oversight.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The vulnerability stems from placing randomly generated 'dice words' to the left of the domain (grok.me), allowing passive DNS logging to capture unique application URLs. [SPLIT] ⚡ SpaceXSI itself fell victim to the flaw, exposing internal onboarding plans, sales territory maps, and advertising proposals across 24 company-built apps. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/grok-build-leak-exposes-spacexsi-secrets-and-thousands-of-apps-682690.html

item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The democratization of geostationary satellite precipitation datasets isn't just a climate breakthrough—it's a paradigm shift for dual-use atmospheric intelligence, operational planning, and theater-level ISR capabilities.
[SPLIT] ⚡ High-temporal-resolution weather inputs serve as dual-use assets, directly enhancing tactical ISR, aviation transit routing, and maritime operations. [SPLIT] ⚡ Machine learning frameworks trained on orbital feeds reduce weather forecasting latency from hours to seconds compared to legacy physics models.
